# Frozen execution fixtures

These files are offline functional inputs, not live-chain captures or performance results.

The `evm-*` and `wbft-*` fixtures come from the isolated [StableNet executor](../../x/stablenet/executor/README.md), whose EVM/WBFT replay and bootstrap contracts remain unchanged.

`arc-storage.json` and `arc-create-gone.json` are generated by the official [Arc executor libraries](../../x/arc/executor/README.md) pinned to `6e764023ee6515fe70573e123ed2db912a7207b4`. They use a **synthetic chain ID 1337/anchor**, derived from the pinned local-development allocation plus public test accounts/contracts. They are not Arc testnet/mainnet genesis or operational checkpoints. Transactions use the public Alloy test signature; no private key is included. The fixture records the source revision, complete synthetic baseline, original parent header, verified EXR1 bytes and expected public state. Arc allocation bytecode is redistributed under the included [Apache-2.0 license](arc-LICENSE.txt); upstream copyright is Circle Internet Group, Inc. Contract dependencies retain their upstream notices in the linked source repository.

Reproduce into an owned temporary directory and compare, without updating fixtures implicitly:

```sh
cd x/arc/executor
INDEXER_ARC_FIXTURE_DIR=/YOUR_OWNED_TEMP_DIRECTORY cargo test --locked --lib tests::frozen_arc_consumer_fixtures_are_reproducible -- --exact
```

The Go app tests independently decode the raw block/body/receipt commitments and exercise the actual disposable PostgreSQL publication/API path. Native library tests independently reconstruct intermediate journal roots and reject omissions/corruption. No node service or live RPC is required.
